text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Passionate, gallant,
and deeply trusted by her juniors,
Hishi Amazon is the dorm head 
of the Miho Dormitory.
She is an Umamusume 
who pours her passion into "one-on-one 
duels."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To her, a race was simply another heated, 
one-on-one brawl where she could clash 
head-on with powerful opponents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon looked forward to the 
showdowns awaiting her in the Twinkle 
Series. Her days of taking on challenges 
were about to begin—!
